title: OpenWarrant Format 1.0: obligation record
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md section 3.7. Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. An obligation is an authored record (record.json) of type `obligation`. `scope` and `evidence` are REQUIRED (`format.field-missing`). `refusal` is RECOMMENDED: its absence is a warning (`format.refusal-missing`), not a refusal, so this schema admits an obligation without it. `disposition`, `verdict`, `state` and `status` MUST NOT be authored (`format.authored-state`): a disposition comes only from a recorded verdict.

scope.description: What the claim covers and, as far as known, what it does not.

evidence.description: The observation that would settle it.

refusal.description: An input the control is observed to reject.

gate.$comment: Each element is common.json#/$defs/gateUri; the separator is `,` with optional spaces.
